name: Irreverent Heresy
source:
Marcos is a man who has been buying and selling objects for many years.
His brother-in-law, Ramón, is a detective who works with the police; He usually brings things that he finds interesting during searches and raids, then Marcos dedicates himself to valuing said material and finding potential buyers.
But everything changed when Ramón gave Marcos a grimoire belonging to the late Madame del Aquelarre.
translation:
马科斯多年来一直从事器物买卖的行当。
他的连襟拉蒙是一名与警方合作的侦探，经常把自己在搜查与突击行动中发现的稀罕物件带给马科斯，再由马科斯负责鉴定估价、物色潜在买家。
然而，当拉蒙将一本属于已故“女巫集会夫人”的魔导书交到马科斯手中时，一切都彻底改变了。
